column1: # Rows db.dxs.* (line RG series D, item xml-stream, 2026-11-27; remaining-gaps DECISIONS D-SO-2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/logs/xml_stream/NCBI.md): BLAST XML (outfmt 5) and the XML2 and JSON documents (16, 15) are written batch by batch, so a title that LOSAT refuses (one NCBI's definition line generator reads past the end of, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS) in a later query batch comes after the output of the batches before (the Owner's decision of 2026-11-16 on line RG's Q-X2c), without the document's end: BATCH_SIZE=1 with na then a query whose title is punctuation (tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_pq.fna, against tests/fasta/outfmt0/xsb_s.fna) or then r, which hits only a subject whose title is punctuation (tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_r.fna against tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_s.fna); the near rows are na alone against each subject file (db.xs.blastn.bat.na.5 is the near row of outfmt 5 against xsb_s.fna). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program blastn --only db.dxs.`.
